claim: Microsoft's GAAP net income was $35.8 billion in fiscal Q4 2026.
summary: The claim asserts a specific Q4 FY2026 GAAP net income figure that falls after the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04 and therefore cannot be verified from own knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft's GAAP net income was $35.8 billion in fiscal Q4 2026.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 predates the end of Microsoft fiscal Q4 2026 (quarter ending June 30, 2026) and its reporting in late July 2026, so the specific GAAP net income figure cannot be established from own knowledge and no citations may be invented.
